en: "Well, well. An unexpected face{n} in an unexpected place."
"The Rheinmetall army's pride, the{n} Special Ground Force, alias the Gungnir{n} Unit. And its leader, Capt. McAuliffe."
"That's right: McAuliffe{n} the Dragon Knight!"
"Hmph, it's been a while, boy!{n} More than a year now since{n} we last met, isn't it?"
"The Dark Knight of the Romulus army's{n} Special Service Agency, who dealt my{n} unit heavy losses at Bastogne!"
"Your name was {hero:6},{n} if I recall!"
"I'm honored you remember..."
"So, will you pull out right now?{n} Do that and I'll spare your lives.{n} Or fight, ready to be wiped out?"
"You piece of shit!"
"You said the same thing back then,{n} then cut down my retreating men{n} from behind without a shred of mercy!"
"I have just one word for you!{n} Clean out your ears and listen well!"
"Nuts!"
"That's all!"
"Heh, you're an old-school soldier.{n} When I see your kind, I get so{n} angry I want to kill you."
"It's like looking at my old man,{n} who died clutching his honor{n} and his pride for dear life!"
"Well, whatever..."
"If you're an old soldier, hurry up{n} and die! This is no place{n} for a geezer to show up!"
"My sword of darkness and your sword{n} of the dragon! Today we settle{n} which is the strongest sword!"
"Big talk, boy!"
"Shut up, geezer!"
"Ah, we are truly in dire straits!{n} Or is this a trial that God{n} has given Mr. {hero:6}!?"
"That's it! It must be!"
"Unless this trial is overcome,{n} the sickness in Mr. {hero:6}'s heart{n} will never be healed!"
"In that case!"
"Let us go, Mr. {hero:6}!{n} To triumph over God's trial!"
"Shut up, Aerial! If you're{n} going to fight, fight quietly!"
"Hey, hey, are you serious?"
"Rheinmetall's Gungnir Unit? Of every{n} country's ground forces, they rank{n} first or second!"
"But don't you worry, {hero:6}!{n} I've wanted to fight this bunch just{n} once! They're a worthy opponent!"
"We're up against that mighty foe!?{n} But Lt. {hero:6} can surely beat{n} even a Dragon Knight, sir!"
"Now, your orders, sir!"
"The enemy is Rheinmetall's strongest{n} unit. But on the pride of Romulus,{n} we cannot lose here!"
"Hmph! So what if he's a Dragon{n} Knight! My Prince {hero:6} is{n} the invincible Dark Knight!"
"A knight of the dragon: a surprise{n} indeed. Our samurai ride horses, but{n} none, of course, rides a dragon."
"A knight who flies the skies..."
"I see. With enough training, humans{n} can ride even a dragon at will."
"This is what truly divides machine{n} and human: they change themselves by{n} effort. Beings of endless potential."
"A Dragon Knight, free to{n} fly the skies?"
"Indeed, a formidable opponent. They{n} can move heedless of terrain, and{n} have mighty knightly skills as well."
"This looks to be a hard fight."
"The Rheinmetall army, you say!?"
"Nothing to fear! They're only a pack{n} of unschooled soldiers who never saw{n} the importance of Item Studies!"
"Flatten them in one go!{n} And I might add, I'm a professor,{n} you know!"
"Listen up! No need to get scared!{n} They're only regular-army wimps!{n} Trust your own strength, got it!?"
"All right! Everyone to your posts!{n} Let's hit them with a bang!"
"Listen, split up the enemy unit!{n} We take them out one by one!{n} Use skills and magic to the full!"
"Impertinent rabble..."
"Taste a Dragon Knight's{n} swordsmanship!"
"Deadly strike! Dragon Storm!"
"Not bad, boy!?"
"You too, geezer!"
"Not bad at all, boy?"
"But you're only a Dark Knight.{n} You can never hope to beat me,{n} a knight of the heavens!"
"Uoooooooooooh!?"
"Impossible!?"
"I, a Dragon Knight, struck down{n} by a mere knight who crawls{n} upon the grouuund!?"
"Ooooooooooooooooh!?"
"Glory to the Rheinmetall army!"
"Tch! I'm battered all over, but{n} it looks like we pulled off a win!"
"Amazing, amazing, amaaaaazing!{n} That's my Prince {hero:6}!{n} I've fallen for you all over agaaain!"
"C'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon, c'mon!{n} Serves you right! A total victory{n} for yours truly and company!"
"A hard battle indeed. But each time{n} you overcome hardship, you too{n} draw nearer to being a true knight."
"I'm a professor, you know? And yet{n} you work me like a dog! I can't{n} move another single step!"
"Victory probability was under 0.8%..."
"And yet we won. Is this human{n} potential? The power of will that{n} makes the impossible possible."
"Splendid!"
"We were outnumbered, yet in the{n} fighting ki we gave off,{n} we surpassed them."
"Ah, thank you, God, for not{n} forsaking Mr. {hero:6}, afflicted with{n} sickness of the heart, to the end."
"Brilliant, Lt. {hero:6}! You are{n} the pride of our army, sir!"
"In the end, seen from our Romulus{n} army, the Rheinmetall army is{n} second-rate or worse!"
"What's that statue?"
"The ring's making a sound?"
"Is this statue resonating with the{n} ring I got at Special Service HQ,{n} the 'Twelve Keys' ring or whatever?"
"You who stand before my statue:{n} are you one who will dispel{n} the darkness of the world?"
"Hey, hey, what's going on here?{n} The statue's yapping away!"
"My name is War God Ares, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"A blink of an eye to us, a long age{n} to you: a hundred years have we{n} marked upon this island."
"And now, upon this island, the seal{n} on us Twelve Gods has been broken."
"Hmph, a well-made machine. It reacts{n} to whoever holds a ring and talks{n} automatically. That's the trick."
"Still, these so-called Ancient Gods{n} sure made nothing but weird stuff."
"Seek out the statues...{n} In lands you have visited once...{n} and in lands you have yet to visit..."
"Find every statue of the Twelve Gods{n} and turn their power into rings."
"When you have gathered all twelve{n} rings, we shall acknowledge you{n} as the agent of the gods."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"The seal has been broken."
"The seal on us Zodiac Twelve Gods{n} has been broken after a hundred years."
"Agent of the gods, huh?{n} Set the course of this world right, huh?"
"Man, what a roundabout way to talk.{n} Basically, I just have to collect{n} twelve rings lying around somewhere."
"And if I do, I get my hands on{n} some incredible power, right?"
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"My name is War God Ares."
"Now is the time to fulfill{n} the ancient covenant."
"My name is War God Ares."
"Now that's a well-made gimmick.{n} In the blink of an eye, the statue{n} turned into this tiny little ring."
"These Ancient Gods who made it{n} must've really loved theatrics."
"Then again, it's sure to be a hit{n} with military men who love theatrics.{n} So bad they can taste it..."
"Well, whatever."
"This ring's supposed to be a key,{n} right? So if I collect twelve, I get{n} to lay eyes on the Almighty Treasure?"
"Looks like this trip just got{n} a bit more interesting."
"It's resonating with the ring I have."
"My name is War God Ares, one of{n} the Zodiac Twelve Gods who watch and{n} govern this world by the stars' course."
"The rings you now hold..."
"The rings that yet remain..."
"Set it right."
"Too little time remains. Gain the{n} power of us Zodiac Twelve Gods and{n} set the course of this world right."
"So that's one step closer to the{n} so-called Almighty Treasure{n} sleeping on this island."
"So the secret shortcut that drifter{n} in Asgard was talking about{n} is this route..."
"All right, that gives us a shortcut{n} to the Volcano Plateau."
"That's odd..."
"By the map Special Service HQ drew{n} up, we should be able to reach the{n} Volcano Plateau from here..."
"I can't find that path anywhere."
"No help for it. We'll take another{n} route to the Volcano Plateau..."
"Me, getting pushed back?{n} Somebody cover me!"
"So strong! They're waaay too strong!?"
"No! I can't give up now!{n} Hector, cover me, pleeease!"
"Tch, not bad!"
"But I absolutely can't lose this!{n} Back me up, will you!"
"Backup! Backup!{n} Waaah! It hurts!{n} But Alice won't give up!"
"Well fought, for an enemy.{n} {name:6}, forgive me,{n} but I need your support!"
"Argh! Son of a bitch!{n} But I won't lose! Never again!{n} Backup! Send help!!"
"Am I... out of healing...?{n} ...Please... cover me..."
"Oh dear, this won't do...{n} I have run out of ways to heal."
"I'm a professor, you know!?{n} Show a little more care, will you!?{n} Hurry up and back me up!"
"Win probability down to 22%!{n} Auto-repair function: off!!{n} Requesting backup!"
"The flow of ki is gathering to the{n} enemy. I have no means of healing{n} left. Please, lend me your support."
"Mm...{n} ...Support...!"
"Lord, please send me aid!{n} I cannot lose here, for I{n} must spread Your teachings!"
"Ngh, they really are strong!{n} And I'm out of healing...{n} Backup, please!"
"Me, a soldier of Romulus, pushed{n} back by a mere foe like this...!{n} Sorry, requesting relief!"
"Li'l Tethys is in a piiinch!{n} Backup, if you please!!{n} Much obliged, yes indeed!"
"Gh...{w:1} Why...{w:1} Me, of all people..."
"I'm sorry...{w:1} Hector..."
"Guess they were...{w:1} way out of my league.{n} Sorry, I'm pulling out first!"
"Uu...{w:3} sniff...{w:3} sniff...{n} Alice...{w:3} lost...{n} Alice is going... {w:5}home..."
"Alas...{w:3} so I am beaten.{n} Forgive me, {w:3}I must withdraw."
"I can...{w:3} still fight...{w:3} I can...{n} ...Damn it! {w:3}Pulling back for now!"
"Pathetic...{w:3} Can't even die...{n} So once again, I alone {w:3}retreat...?"
"It seems...{w:3} over these centuries...{n} my magic, too...{w:3} has waned...{n} Allow me {w:3}to withdraw first!"
"Why...{w:3} did I...{w:3} lose?{n} I'm...{w:3} a professor, I tell you...{n} Retreat, {w:3}retreat! {w:3}Running is winning!"
"Damage rate...{w:3} 59.7%...{n} Self-repair {w:3}limit reached.{n} Moving to camp."
"I could not...{w:3} control the flow of ki...{n} ...{w:3}I can make...{w:3} no excuses.{n} I will...{w:3} return...{w:3} ahead of you..."
"Defeat...{n} {w:3}Withdrawing..."
"Ah...{w:3} so I have lost...{n} Lord, {w:3}forgive me...{n} I will go back {w:3}to camp {w:3}ahead of you..."
"Ngh...{w:3} I'm sorry...{n} {hero:6}...{w:3} Lieutenant, sir...{n} I'm pulling back {w:3}ahead of you..."
"...{w:3}A proud...{w:3} soldier of Romulus,{n} beaten...{w:3} so disgracefully...{n} Sorry... {w:3}I'm withdrawing!!"
"Li'l Tethys loses!{n} Withdrawing, if you please!!{n} The rest is yours, yes indeed!"
